# Aaqif Shafi — Full-Stack Product Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Aaqif Shafi, a full-stack product engineer based in Kashmir, India. Building end-to-end products with NestJS, Next.js, and everything in between.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to give language models a concise, structured summary of the site.

## About

- Name: Aaqif Shafi (@aaqifshafi)
- Role: Full-Stack Product Engineer
- Location: Kashmir, India

## Experience

- Designfolio — Full-Stack Product Engineer (May 2026 – Present)
  Portfolio builder for designers and developers. Built the full jobs board (scraping, Kanban, AI match scoring), mock interview, resume tailor, cover letter generation, Tiptap case study editor, and dynamic templates. Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Tiptap, PostgreSQL.

- Gistr Technologies — Fullstack Product Engineer (Jan 2025 – Apr 2026)
  AI knowledge workspace. File ingestion pipelines (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, podcasts, web), credit-based billing with Dodo Payments, BullMQ job queues, PostHog analytics, core AI features. NestJS, Next.js, BullMQ, MongoDB.

- Payoll Payments LLC — Software Engineering Intern (Sep 2024 – Jan 2025)
  B2B payments consolidation API and Ared carbon footprint calculator with carbon credit marketplace. Express, Vite, PostgreSQL.

## Projects

- Chat With PDF: Conversational AI for semantic document search. Next.js, LangChain, Pinecone, OpenAI. https://github.com/aaqifshafi/chat-with-pdf
- College Management System: Full-stack educational platform with Stripe payments, AI question paper generation, student and admin portals. https://github.com/aaqifshafi/G-CET
